I have everything, verified empirically rather than inferred. Here is the report.

## Verdict: the claim's **conclusion is TRUE**, but its **stated mechanism is FALSE**

`styles.popoverContent` genuinely is `undefined` and genuinely is a silent dead spread. But it is *not* undefined "because `popoverContent` is absent from the `parts` array" — Chakra's `parts` does not gate `baseStyle` at all.

---

### 1. The read — TRUE, exact anchor

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx`

- **L299:** `{...styles.popoverContent}` — on the `<PopoverContent>` element (opens L298, `{...getAccountMenuDisclosureProps()}` at L306).
- **L179:** `const styles = useMultiStyleConfig('Header');` — the live binding, no options object.
- **L110:** `//   const styles = useMultiStyleConfig('Header');` — a second, dead occurrence inside a fully commented-out `SearchBar` (L109-121).

Confirmed already-merged: `git diff HEAD` is empty for both files; last touch `a728bea`.

### 2. Override recipe — `popoverContent` ABSENT (TRUE)

`/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/header.ts`
- `parts` (L6-25), **17**: container, content, searchContainer, bodyContainer, logo, icons, agentIcon, wishlistIcon, accountIcon, arrowDown, signout, signoutIcon, signoutText, topBar, logoBar, logoButton, desktopActionButton
- `baseStyle` (L26-110), **8**: container, content, bodyContainer, topBar, logoBar, logoButton, logo, desktopActionButton
- No `variants`, no `sizes`. **No `popoverContent`.**

### 3. Base SFCC recipe — `popoverContent` ABSENT (TRUE), but it exists on a *different* recipe

`node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/theme/components/project/header.js` (the only Header source; registered at `.../app/theme/index.js:39,90`)
- `baseStyle` (L8-81), **13**: container, content, searchContainer, bodyContainer, logo, icons, agentIcon, accountIcon, arrowDown, wishlistIcon, signout, signoutText, signoutIcon
- `parts` (L82-92), **9** — note it omits accountIcon, arrowDown, signoutText, signoutIcon *which are in baseStyle*. This is the load-bearing evidence for §5.
- **No `popoverContent`.** Nothing in `theme/components/base/` defines a Header.

**`popoverContent` does exist — on ListMenu, not Header:** `project/list-menu.js:22` (baseStyle) and `:98` (parts); override `overrides/app/theme/components/listMenu.ts:103`. So L299 is a cross-recipe name mixup.

**This is inherited upstream, not Zimmermann-introduced:** `node_modules/@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/components/header/index.jsx:265` has the identical dead `{...styles.popoverContent}` off `useMultiStyleConfig('Header')`. The override copied it verbatim.

### 4. Composition — deep MERGE, not replacement

`overrides/app/theme/index.ts:64` → `extendTheme(baseTheme, overrides)`. `createExtendTheme` → `mergeThemeOverride` → `lodash.mergewith` with a customizer that returns `undefined` for non-function values, i.e. default deep merge (`node_modules/@chakra-ui/theme-utils/dist/chunk-AQYX3YP4.mjs:15-43`). Merged Header `baseStyle` = 13 ∪ 8 = **17 keys**. The repo documents this itself at `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts:347-351`: *"extendTheme DEEP MERGES… Header/ListMenu are partial overrides of components whose other parts we still rely on."*

### 5. What `styles.popoverContent` actually evaluates to — proven, not inferred

`resolveStyleConfig` (`node_modules/@chakra-ui/styled-system/dist/index.mjs:1686-1698`):

```js
return mergeWith4({},
  runIfFn3(config.baseStyle ?? {}, props),   // <- ALL baseStyle keys, unfiltered
  recipe(config, "sizes",    size,    props), // <- config.parts consulted ONLY here
  recipe(config, "variants", variant, props)) // <- and here
```

`config.parts` is read only inside `createResolver` (L1657 `const isMultipart = !!config.parts`), which serves `sizes`/`variants`. **`baseStyle` is spread verbatim.** The base recipe proves it: `accountIcon`/`arrowDown`/`signoutText`/`signoutIcon` are in base `baseStyle` but *not* in base `parts`, and they resolve fine (used live at L289/345/346/391).

I ran the real Chakra functions against the real recipes:

```
merged baseStyle   : 17
resolved keys      : 17  (identical set — parts had zero effect)
styles.popoverContent = undefined
'popoverContent' in styles = false
reads resolving to undefined: ["popoverContent"]
Object.assign({}, undefined)     -> {}
object-spread {...undefined}      -> {}
spread undefined + sibling props -> {"onMouseLeave":"fn"}
```

**Silent no-op confirmed, not a crash** — both JSX transform shapes (`_extends`/`Object.assign` and native object spread) ignore `undefined` sources per spec, and sibling props on the same element survive intact. It's also *invisible*, because Chakra's own `Popover` recipe styles `PopoverContent` regardless — which is why it survived review.

**Full cross-check of every `styles.X` in header/index.tsx** (17 live reads): all resolve **except `popoverContent` (L299)**. The only other mismatch is `styles.search` (L118) — but that sits inside the commented-out `SearchBar` block, so it is dead code, not a live read. (`styles.searchContainer`, L117, same block, would actually resolve.)

### 6. Full population of this defect class — header is the ONLY instance repo-wide

I resolved every `useMultiStyleConfig`/`useStyleConfig` call site under `overrides/app/components/**` (including non-`styles` bindings, which the repo's own guard can't see), mapped each to its recipe, and diffed reads against both `parts` and `baseStyle`:

| Component | Recipe | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `footer/index.tsx:88` | `footer/footer.css.ts` | clean (8/8) |
| `footer/bottomBar/index.tsx:31` | `bottomBar.css.ts` | clean (8/8) |
| `footer/footerNavColumn/index.tsx:35` | `footerNavColumn.css.ts` | clean (4/4) |
| **`header/index.tsx:299`** | `theme/components/header.ts` | **`popoverContent` undefined** |
| `zimmModal/index.tsx:42` | `zimmModal.css.ts` | clean |
| `zimmTextInput/index.tsx:80` | `zimmTextInput.css.ts` | clean |
| `zimmProductStyleCode/index.tsx:48` | `zimmProductStyleCode.css.ts` | clean |
| `zimmContactIconRow/index.tsx:49` | `zimmContactIconRow.css.ts` | clean |
| `zimmProductMeta/index.tsx:30` | `zimmProductMeta.css.ts` | clean |
| `zimmSubscribeModal/index.tsx:37` (`chrome`) + `:38` (`styles`) | `zimmModal.css.ts` + `zimmSubscribeModal.css.ts` | clean, incl. the `chrome.actions` read the repo guard admits it can't see |
| `zimmSubscribeSection/index.tsx:51` | `zimmSubscribeSection.css.ts` | clean |
| 6 × `useStyleConfig` single-part atoms | — | N/A (style object, not parts) |

`zimmProductStyleCode.css.ts:25` and `zimmTextInput.css.ts:80` declare `baseStyle` as a **function** returning the parts map — `runIfFn` handles it, so both are fine (an initial parse flagged them as false positives).

So: **`overrides/app/components/header/index.tsx:299` is the sole instance**, and it is outside `ui-kits/`.

---

### Two secondary findings worth flagging

**a) The guard gap is real and self-documented.** `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/recipeParts.test.ts` passes (11 tests) but is strictly sibling-based (`.css.ts` + `index.tsx` in the same directory), so `theme/components/header.ts` is structurally out of reach. Its own docstring (L18-23) says exactly this: *"`theme/components/header.ts` is the only multipart recipe in that position today and is therefore unguarded."* I confirmed `recipeGuards.test.ts` has 6 tests, none a parts-vs-reads check. Accurate as written.

**b) That guard's stated rationale is wrong, which matters if anyone extends it.** `recipeParts.test.ts:5-7` asserts *"Chakra returns a styles object keyed by the recipe's `parts`; reading a key that is not declared yields `undefined`."* Per §5 that is false for `baseStyle` — `parts` gates only `sizes`/`variants`. The test still happens to work because in all 10 co-located recipes `parts` and `baseStyle` keys are identical sets, making reads-vs-`parts` an exact proxy today. But it is a proxy: it would **miss** a read present in `parts` yet absent from `baseStyle` (the actual runtime failure), and **falsely flag** the reverse — which is precisely the shape the base SFCC header recipe already has (4 baseStyle keys absent from its `parts`, all working). Worth correcting the docstring and re-pointing the comparison at `baseStyle` keys if that guard is ever extended to cover `theme/components/`.
